name: lib_orderOf_eq_prime_of_card_prime_mul_prime_of_not_isCyclic
statement: (p q : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hq : Nat.Prime q) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p * q) (hnc : ¬ IsCyclic G) (a : G) (ha : a ≠ 1) : orderOf a = p ∨ orderOf a = q
closed: ∀ (p q : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hq : Nat.Prime q) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p * q) (hnc : ¬ IsCyclic G) (a : G) (ha : a ≠ 1), orderOf a = p ∨ orderOf a = q
informal: promoted from Mathlib2.bld3_card_conjClasses_of_card_prime_mul_prime_aux1 (order part, hypothesis weakened from non-abelian to non-cyclic): in a non-cyclic group of order pq every non-identity element has order p or q. (The aux lemma also gives |C(a)| = orderOf a in the non-abelian case.)
type: ∀ (p q : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → Nat.Prime q → ∀ (G : Type u_1) [inst : Group G], Nat.card G = p * q → ¬IsCyclic G → ∀ (a : G), a ≠ 1 → orderOf a = p ∨ orderOf a = q
